raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`EmbeddingRequest` is a five-member pydantic union with no discriminator, so every `/v1/embeddings` body is validated against all five. The chat-input members (#45173) check each input item against every chat message type, so a 256×64 token-id batch spends ~66 ms in validation on the API server's event loop. This tries `EmbeddingCompletionRequest` first when `input` is not chat-shaped and the body has no chat-only field, and otherwise (or on any error) falls back to the original union.

## Claims

- Validation of plain inputs: 256×64 token ids ~66 ms → 0.28 ms, 256 strings 818 → 44 µs, 1 string 20 → 4.8 µs.
- Parsed requests, `errors()` and HTTP 400 bodies are unchanged; chat bodies take the original path (+~0.4 µs for the check).
- Reach: `/v1/embeddings` (and `run_batch`) with string or token-id input. The Rust frontend has no embeddings route.

## Validation

A/B, 15 alternated rounds, fresh process per run, validation through the route's FastAPI body field; macOS arm64, Python 3.12.7, pydantic 2.14.1:

| body | main | PR |
|---|---|---|
| 256×64 token ids | 65.6 ms | 0.28 ms |
| 32×512 token ids | 64.9 ms | 0.15 ms |
| 256 strings | 818 µs | 44 µs |
| 1 chat conversation | 32.3 µs | 32.7 µs |
| ScoreRequest (control) | 15.6 µs | 15.7 µs |

<details>
<summary>Reproduce</summary>

```python
import time
from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from vllm.entrypoints.pooling.embed.protocol import EmbeddingRequest

ta = TypeAdapter(EmbeddingRequest)
body = {"model": "m", "input": [list(range(64)) for _ in range(256)]}
ta.validate_python(body)
t = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(20):
    ta.validate_python(body)
print(f"{(time.perf_counter() - t) / 20 * 1e3:.2f} ms")  # main 68.3, PR 0.26
```
</details>

Identity vs main: 55 valid bodies (every input shape and option, chat/batched/chat-as-input variants, both `input` and `messages`) parse to the same class and `model_dump()` over HTTP and through `run_batch`; 35 invalid bodies give the same status and errors.

```
pytest tests/entrypoints/pooling/embed/test_io_processor.py
# 64 passed
```

The new tests compare against the plain union for 11 valid and 4 invalid bodies; the invalid set fails if the chat-only-field check is removed. Evals: N/A, model inputs are unchanged. End-to-end server latency was not measured; numbers are the validation step only.

Not a duplicate: no open or closed PR touches this union (`EmbeddingRequest`, `embeddings discriminator`, `pooling protocol union`).

## Details

Only the completion member can accept a non-chat `input` without `messages`, so when it validates, the result matches the union. Bodies with a chat-only field (`_CHAT_ONLY_FIELDS`, derived from `EmbeddingChatRequest.model_fields`) skip the fast path, because chat-member validators can reject them with a non-`ValidationError` (e.g. `continue_final_message` + `add_generation_prompt`). A `WrapValidator` is used instead of a `Discriminator`, which would change error `loc`s and the OpenAPI schema (`anyOf` → `oneOf`). Only cosmetic difference: `ValidationError.title` names the wrapper, visible in the first line of `run_batch` error strings.

AI assistance (Claude Opus 5.5) was used to find this target, draft the patch, and build the benchmark and identity check. I reviewed every line, re-ran the tests, and benchmarks above myself, and can answer for the change and where the perf wins come from.

---

 """Unit tests for EmbedIOProcessor."""
 
+from typing import get_args
+
 import pytest
 import torch
 from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError
@@ -110,6 +112,65 @@ def test_batched_messages_parses_as_batch_chat_request(self):
         ]
         assert request.chat_template_kwargs == {"instruction": "Represent the query: "}
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "body",
+        [
+            {"input": "hello"},
+            {"input": [[1, 2], [3]]},
+            {"input": []},
+            {"input": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]},
+            {"input": [[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]]},
+            {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]},
+            {"messages": [[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]]},
+            {"messages": []},
+            {"messages": [{"author": {"role": "user"}, "content": []}]},
+            {"input": "hello", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}]},
+            {
+                "input": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+                "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+            },
+        ],
+    )
+    def test_parses_like_plain_union(self, body):
+        """The completion fast path must parse like the plain union."""
+        plain_union = TypeAdapter(get_args(EmbeddingRequest)[0])
+        expected = plain_union.validate_python(body)
+        request: EmbeddingRequest = TypeAdapter(EmbeddingRequest).validate_python(body)
+
+        assert type(request) is type(expected)
+        assert request.model_dump(exclude={"request_id"}) == expected.model_dump(
+            exclude={"request_id"}
+        )
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "body",
+        [
+            {"input": [1, "a"]},
+            {"input": [[1], "x"]},
+            {"input": "x", "dimensions": "abc"},
+            {
+                "input": "x",
+                "continue_final_message": True,
+                "add_generation_prompt": True,
+            },
+        ],
+    )
+    def test_rejects_like_plain_union(self, body):
+        """Invalid bodies must fail exactly as the plain union fails them."""
+        plain_union = TypeAdapter(get_args(EmbeddingRequest)[0])
+        with pytest.raises(Exception) as expected:
+            plain_union.validate_python(body)
+        with pytest.raises(Exception) as actual:
+            TypeAdapter(EmbeddingRequest).validate_python(body)
+
+        assert type(actual.value) is type(expected.value)
+        if isinstance(expected.value, ValidationError):
+            assert actual.value.errors(include_url=False) == expected.value.errors(
+                include_url=False
+            )
+        else:
+            assert str(actual.value) == str(expected.value)
+
 
 class TestCohereEmbedRequestParsing:
     """Unit tests for Cohere embed request parsing."""

 import numpy as np
 import pybase64 as base64
-from pydantic import BaseModel, BeforeValidator, Field, model_validator
+from pydantic import (
+    BaseModel,
+    BeforeValidator,
+    Field,
+    ValidationError,
+    ValidatorFunctionWrapHandler,
+    WrapValidator,
+    model_validator,
+)
 
 from vllm import PoolingParams
 from vllm.entrypoints.serve.engine.protocol import OpenAIBaseModel, UsageInfo
@@ -156,12 +164,36 @@ def normalize_input_messages(cls, data):
         return normalized
 
 
+_CHAT_ONLY_FIELDS = frozenset(EmbeddingChatRequest.model_fields).difference(
+    EmbeddingCompletionRequest.model_fields
+)
+
+
+def _validate_embedding_request(data: Any, handler: ValidatorFunctionWrapHandler):
+    # Smart-mode union validation tries every member, and the chat members are
+    # slow to reject plain inputs, so try the completion request first when no
+    # chat member could accept the body.
+    if (
+        isinstance(data, dict)
+        and "input" in data
+        and _CHAT_ONLY_FIELDS.isdisjoint(data)
+        and not _is_chat_messages(data["input"])
+        and not _is_batched_chat_messages(data["input"])
+    ):
+        try:
+            return EmbeddingCompletionRequest.model_validate(data)
+        except ValidationError:
+            pass
+    return handler(data)
+
+
 EmbeddingRequest: TypeAlias = Annotated[
     EmbeddingCompletionRequest
     | EmbeddingChatRequest
     | EmbeddingBatchChatRequest
     | EmbeddingChatInputRequest
     | EmbeddingBatchChatInputRequest,
+    WrapValidator(_validate_embedding_request),
     BeforeValidator(reject_removed_pooling_parameters),
 ]
